To be eligible for entry, work must have been published or produced between 1 JANUARY 2022 and 31 DECEMBER 2023 . Work created while a student is not eligible. Download an information pack HERE and enter your work now. ISTD is recognised as a leading worldwide community of designers, educators, and typography specialists. Our members are committed to inspiring a love for all forms of typography, while cultivating and promoting the highest standards of typographic practice. Apply for MEMBERSHIP and benefit from an entry discount.
